title: Event Cycle
description: A cycle of consecutive LHB events for a single stock.

cycle_id.description: Unique identifier for the event cycle.

stock_id.description: Identifier of the stock this cycle belongs to.

cycle_start.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the cycle started.

last_event_date.description: ISO-8601 date of the most recent event in the cycle.

cycle_end.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the cycle ended, or null if still active.

event_count.description: Number of LHB events in this cycle.
